cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_ktextaddons CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# The KF6<TextAddon>…Config.cmake files installed by ktextaddons chain through
# the Qt6 and other KF6 targets without a find_dependency() of their own, so
# load Qt6 first and then the KF6 components referenced by their link
# interfaces (conan_kf6_components.cmake is generated by conanfile.py and
# found through CMAKE_MODULE_PATH, which the toolchain points at the
# generators folder).
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Widgets)
include(conan_kf6_components OPTIONAL)
find_package(KF6TextUtils REQUIRED)
find_package(KF6TextAddonsWidgets REQUIRED)
find_package(KF6TextEmoticonsCore REQUIRED)

# Consumer smoke test: real public APIs of the leaf libraries.
add_executable(test_ktextaddons test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(
    test_ktextaddons
    PRIVATE
        KF6::TextUtils
        KF6::TextAddonsWidgets
        KF6::TextEmoticonsCore
        # KF6TextAddonsWidgets links Qt6::Widgets PRIVATEly, so the include
        # paths do not propagate; link Qt6 directly for the QWidget usage.
        Qt6::Core
        Qt6::Gui
        Qt6::Widgets
)

# HarmonyOS 专项测试：安装产物层面的 OHOS 适配断言（DT_SONAME / 插件目录 /
# 组件库安装完整性），不依赖任何上游测试入口。
add_executable(test_ktextaddons_ohos ohos_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(
    test_ktextaddons_ohos
    PRIVATE
        KF6::TextAddonsWidgets
        KF6::TextUtils
        Qt6::Core
        Qt6::Gui
        Qt6::Widgets
)
target_compile_options(test_ktextaddons_ohos PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)

enable_testing()
add_test(NAME test_ktextaddons COMMAND test_ktextaddons)
add_test(NAME test_ktextaddons_ohos COMMAND test_ktextaddons_ohos)
